title: Square White Background Sneaker
tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

judge.summary: A clean marketplace-style photo shows one complete white leather sneaker against a plain white background with no distracting additions.

must_haves.why: The image has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must_haves.why: One white sneaker with a smooth leather-looking upper is visible.

must_haves.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must_haves.why: The background is white and empty apart from a natural shadow beneath the shoe.

must_haves.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must_haves.why: The heel, toe, upper and sole are fully within the frame with surrounding margins.

must_haves.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.
must_haves.why: No text, badges or borders are visible.
